system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you hit a creature with an attack or a creature fails a saving throw versus a jutsu you cast, you can spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, if you are under any jutsu based effects that require you to make remake your saving throw to end, you can select one member of your Squad, allowing them to make a saving throw using their statistics in place of your own, ending the effect on you, on a success.
